en: Colorized postcard view of a riverside castle complex with a long white building covered partly in ivy, red gabled roof, green shutters, and adjacent older gabled wings. In the foreground is a calm river reflecting the buildings and a high stone embankment. To the right stands a small pavilion with a red roof among trees. German text at the top identifies the location and type of building.
